chunks: And in the narration of ʿAbdullāh ibn Sinān, from him, peace be upon him:
"It is marked (Ishʿār) while it is restrained."

key_terms.تُشْعَرُ: it is marked by ishʿār, a sign placed on the sacrificial animal
key_terms.عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلَامُ: peace be upon him; honorific for the Imam

ai.seo_question: How should the sacrificial animal be marked during hajj according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states the ruling concerning the marking of the sacrificial animal for hajj. It indicates that the animal is to undergo ishʿār while it is restrained, describing the manner in which this rite is performed.
